purpose.zh: 练把双腿高高抬起、贴近身体的力量
purpose.en: Build the strength to pull your legs up high toward your body.

text.zh: 大腿折向胸口，双腿抬高成V字
text.en: Fold your thighs toward your chest and lift your legs into a V
Support on your hands and press your shoulders down.

text.zh: 靠大腿往胸口收来抬腿，别整个人往后倒。
text.en: Lift by pulling your thighs toward your chest, not by leaning your whole body back.

cautions.zh: 手腕不舒服时先活动一下手腕
cautions.en: If your wrists feel stiff, warm them up first.

cautions.zh: 手腕或肩膀疼时缩短时间，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your wrists or shoulders hurt, hold for less time, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: purpose 去掉「屈髋压缩」，cue3 去掉「屈髋」
